questions.stem: Which of the following is an example of continuous data?
questions.explanation: Continuous data can take any value within a range and is measured. Height can be $1.732\text{ m}$, $1.7321\text{ m}$, etc. Number of siblings and shoe size are discrete, and favourite colour is categorical (qualitative).

questions.stem: Which of the following is qualitative (categorical) data?
questions.explanation: Qualitative data describes a quality or category and is non-numerical. Eye colour (blue, brown, green, etc.) is qualitative. The others are all quantitative (numerical).
